instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high.
Butter one side of a tortilla with 1/2 tsp of the butter and lay it in the pan, butter side down.
Scatter about 1/3 cup of the cheese over one half of the tortilla and fold the other half over it.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes, until the bottom is golden. Flip and cook until the cheese has melted and the edges are crisp.
Move it to a cutting board and cut it into triangles. Repeat with the rest of the tortillas, butter and cheese.
method_notes: Easy Cheese Quesadillas from the Dairy Council (drink-milk.com) leads: a buttered flour tortilla folded over cheese and browned on both sides in a skillet over medium-high. Other pages use oil instead of butter and stack two tortillas, but folding is easier to flip. Cheddar, Monterey Jack or a mix all work.
